answer.rationale: Rollback is ruled out by compliance (security patch), so memory_b1's playbook is unavailable. Read replicas (b5) address read load, not the write path. Circuit breakers (b4) target a partner dependency outage, which isn't indicated. The choice is between regional failover and adding capacity. Failover (b2) restored latency quickly in March, but failing over at peak settlement with heavy writes risks in-flight write loss, and since the suspect release would also be running in the secondary region, failover may not remove the cause. Adding capacity (b3) directly addresses resource saturation on the write path, carries no risk of losing customer writes, and is reversible — it also buys headroom to diagnose whether the new release is the driver before any failover is considered.
